title: The team measured live beside the rules and the single agent, its gate fixed before the run
request: Phase 6 (the owner): measure the teams; about EUR 4 a dev pass, the sealed set once; $20 for testing and improving the two agentic systems.
plan: Three arms on the same people: the rules, the single agent (the loop with the conversation reader), the team (the graph with the reader and the critic's model).
A gate fixed in code before any request.
A fresh sealed set, written by an agent that never read the rules, frozen first.
Dev first; the sealed set once.

decisions.decision: A fifth sealed set, written and pinned before the team was measured.
decisions.why: The four sealed sets were each read once; a set an arm has seen cannot judge it.

decisions.decision: Each live model with its own share of the cap; a run with a failed request is not stored.
decisions.why: A request that failed is answered by the rules, so the arm would partly be the rules.

decisions.decision: Every live journey's whole record kept in agent_runs/live_tests.
decisions.why: The owner's rule: record everything a run does, whole, permanently.

change: journeys --team-arms (TEAM_GATE, the three arms, the cap shares, the records kept), GATE_V5 and the fifth sealed set; the walk takes a critic model; a critic's question with no answer is declined, never a stop.

findings.defect: The team stopped on six of the fifteen dev people.
findings.scenario: JRN-013: the critic's model asked what one row is or what the outcome means; the written person held no answer for that field; the walk waited for the person and built nothing (9 of 15 against 15 for the rules and the single agent).
findings.cause: A critic's question was treated as blocking as the card's own questions are.
findings.fix: A critic's question with no answer is declined, recorded on the question; its concern stands, and the person decides at the critic's gate whether to build on.

findings.defect: On the fifth sealed set the team stopped on a time-to-event person (JS5-18) that the single agent built.
findings.scenario: The outcome question was answered with words that mention days_subscribed and cancelled without starting with either; on the identical prompt the conversation reader quoted the column for the single agent and left it out for the team; the card kept blocking on the outcome, the Home agent had no question left to ask, and the walk stopped with no progress.
findings.cause: The card's own question is never asked twice, so an outcome left open after its answer had no way back to the person: the walk depended on one model reading.
findings.fix: conversation.outcome_again (dclab-core 0.74.0): when the outcome was asked, its answers named the table's columns, and the card still blocks on it, the Home agent asks once more (target_check) with those columns as options; the answer reads as any outcome answer.

findings.defect: The quick gate on the commits after 29.5 failed in four files.
findings.scenario: check-quick on af7a67d: two new workflow points with no reason in NOT_LEARNED, the real problems' runner calling a tool outside the harness's recorded callers, the knowledge base's folder under research/ read as a track, and the data catalog not regenerated.
findings.cause: Commits made without the gate passing first (the owner's rule is to run it before pushing).
findings.fix: The two points' reasons added; the runner listed with the measurement harnesses it is; the knowledge base moved to evidence/business_examples/; the catalog and the research index regenerated.

measurements.name: the dev team arms, first pass (JRN-011 to JRN-013)
measurements.gate: TEAM_GATE (team_gate_v1), fixed in code before the run
measurements.result: rules 15 of 15, single agent 15 of 15, team 9 of 15 (card 15, workflow 9, pipeline 9, holdout 9); EUR 0.105 the single agent, EUR 0.320 the team (EUR 0.021 a journey), no request failed
measurements.against_gate: Failed on the workflow, the pipeline and the holdout: the walk stopped on questions the people could not answer.
limits: Dev people written for the rules' questions: six hold no answer about the unit the critic asked about.

measurements.name: the dev team arms, second pass after the decline fix (JRN-014 to JRN-016)
measurements.gate: TEAM_GATE (team_gate_v1), fixed in code before the first pass
measurements.result: rules 15 of 15, single agent 15 of 15, team 15 of 15 on every part; EUR 0.105 the single agent, EUR 0.415 the team (EUR 0.028 a journey), no request failed
measurements.against_gate: Met on dev: the team at least the rules on every part, its card as often right as the single agent's, within the cap a journey.
limits: Dev people: the gate's strict test is the sealed set, where the team must beat the single agent on the card.
A dev pass after a fix made on dev's own failures is optimistic by construction.

measurements.name: the fifth sealed set, once (JRN-017 to JRN-019)
measurements.gate: TEAM_GATE (team_gate_v1) and journeys_gate_v5, fixed in code before any run
measurements.result: rules 16 of 30 (card 21, workflow 20, pipeline 20, holdout 18); single agent 26 of 30 (95% interval 0.703 to 0.947; card 29, workflow 30, pipeline 30, holdout 27); team 25 of 30 (card 29, workflow 29, pipeline 29, holdout 26); EUR 0.2659 the single agent, EUR 0.8912 the team (EUR 0.0297 a journey, 65 critic requests EUR 0.5825), no request failed, no move refused
measurements.against_gate: Failed: on a sealed set the team's card must be right more often than the single agent's, and it was right as often (29 and 29); it also lost a time-to-event journey the single agent built. The single agent passed the suite's own gate (26 of 30, 95% interval 0.703 to 0.947); the team stays off: team_passed() is false and the rules serve.
limits: Thirty people: one journey is the whole difference between the two live arms.

Four of the five failures are shared by both arms and the rules (folds grouped by biker, a regression read as time to event, a weather column read as known ahead on two forecasts): the engine and the card, not the team.
The sealed set is spent: the fix below is measured only on a fresh sealed set.

outcome: The team measured live against the rules and the single agent, its gate fixed first: the dev pass failed, taught a fix and passed; the fifth sealed set failed the team's gate (25 of 30 against the single agent's 26), so the team stays off and the rules serve.
lessons: A critic's question is advice the person may decline: a send-back must never become a stop the person did not choose.
A step that only a model's reading can move needs a way back to the person: a question asked once more, narrower, before a stop.
A sealed set judges once: its failures are read for causes and fixed on dev, never measured again on the same people.
